scheme_name: Grant of Financial Assistance to Poor Scheduled Caste Pregnant & Lactating Women
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must have continuous residence in Puducherry for at least 3 years
Applicant must be pregnant and lactating
Application must be made from 6 months of pregnancy up to 3 months after delivery
Grant is available for a maximum of two deliveries
benefits_summary: ₹12,000 per delivery, paid as ₹2,000 per month for three months before delivery and ₹2,000 per month for three months after delivery
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
